name: Multi-linear Isosurface Coefficient Calculation
definition: A method to calculate the coefficients of the multi-variate polynomial representing a multi-linearly interpolated level set (LS) function within a grid cell, optimized to reduce numerical operations compared to straightforward calculation.
summary: Multi-linear Isosurface Coefficient Calculation efficiently converts corner level set values into polynomial coefficients for root finding, optimizing arithmetic operations compared to straightforward expansion.
